title: After nearly 17 years apart, Mary Jane Veloso returns home to Nueva Ecija
summary: Nearly 17 years after she was separated from her family, Mary Jane Veloso finally returned home to Nueva Ecija on Saturday, where she was met with an emotional embrace from her family members.
